simple.meaning: קוּץ (qûwts) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to spend the harvest season.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 18:6. The surrounding contexts include mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קוּץ (H6972) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קוּץ (qûwts) / H6972 is traced through Isaiah 18:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H6972. quts קַ֫יִץ noun masculine Jer 8:20 summer, summer-fruit (compare Greek Θέρος in both meanings); — absolute ׳ק Gen 8:22 +; קָ֑יִץ Amos 3:15 +; suffix קֵיצֵךְ Isa 16:9 ; Jer 48:32 ; — 1 summer-season, opposed to חֹרֶף Gen 8:22 (J), Amos 3:15 ; Zech 14:8 ; Psa 74:17 ; || קָצִיר Jer 8:20 ; Prov 6:8 ; 10:5 ; 26:1 , also (without קָצִיר ) 30:25 ; as fruit harvest Isa 28:4 ; time of drought Psa 32:4 (figurative). 2 summer-fruit 2Sam 16:1-2 , Amos 8:1-2 , Jer 40:10 , 12 also, || בָּצִיר , 48:32 ; Micah 7:1 (in simile), but || קציר Isa 16:9 (assimilated to ק of קַיִץ ; read probably בציר ). קִיצוֺן see קצץ
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to clip off; used only as denominative from 7019 ;

occurrences.englishText: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.
